Author: kaldigo
Name: Accord
Description: Configures the compatible Wrathful Combo engine through its settings API and manages static/live hotbars. Includes compact PvE/PvP layouts, three-bar manual logout fallback with login restoration, and automatic Sprint conversion on active hotbars. Development preview.
Punchline: Reviewed intent settings and matching hotbars.
Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: Teleport home while Return is on cooldown, with optional fare confirmation. Sync shared hotbars between PvE and PvP: initially copy PvE, then synchronize changes in either direction. Each feature is independently enabled.
Punchline: Paid Return fallback and shared PvE/PvP hotbar sync.
Changelog: 0.2.1: Add Shared Hotbar Sync as the second feature. Initially copy shared PvE hotbar assignments into PvP, then sync edits and clears in both directions with per-character history, mode-appropriate Sprint, conflict choices and local backups. Include shared cross hotbars. Pause during combat/loading and on failed writes or unreadable history. Keep Return via Teleport and its optional confirmation-skip setting in the Pandora-style feature browser. All former Aetherworks features and the KamiToolKit dependency remain removed. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.

Author: NightmareXIV, kawaii
Name: AutoRetainer
Description: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Punchline: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Changelog:
Steward decision-review integration: optional collection sweep reuses existing retainer postprocessing; read-only disposal selection shares the original hard-list predicate and enabled methods. Original identity, recoloured icon, workflows and protocol-6 safety gates remain unchanged. Paired Steward update intended for log-only decision validation; native execution acceptance remains pending.

Protocol 6 storage preview: optional companion-owned overflow pass reuses bell/retainer/postprocess workflows and native entrust command. Exact per-item Store bridge, unique/space guards and destination acknowledgements retain pending review on uncertainty. Original identity, icon and existing functionality remain unchanged. Native acceptance pending.

Repeated safety review: protocol 5 and an independent synchronous policy ledger replace the incorrect assumption that EzConfig writes propagate disk failures. Managed NPC/retainer sales, desynthesis and armoire storage journal before submission and require exact acknowledgement; remaining jobs wait. Ordinary config imports cannot remove ownership. Review/detach reject backlogged work. Withdrawal binds retainer/HQ and pause managers retain pending transaction guards. Original identity and workflows remain. Native acceptance and safe cross-zone collection refresh are still pending.

Author: kaldigo; based on MidoriKami's ExpandedHotbars
Name: ExpandedHotbars Plus
Description: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Punchline: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source e99e068923f94a8c24842b710a024cb8a2b4a51a. Build, configuration, merge-policy and package checks passed. Preserves the fork's auto-close and icon customizations. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Steward
Description: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Punchline: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Changelog:
Decision-review update: persistent Universalis average-value summaries, configurable six-hour refresh and optional per-rule daily-sales thresholds. Retains older known values for slow sellers without authorizing disposal from missing sales. Logs collection destinations, overflow, sale evidence and individual holds. Adds supplemental collection and quantity reserves, protects reserves across listing splits, fixes headerless cache imports and reduces repeated scans. Paired AutoRetainer update adds collection sweeps and disposal-selection checks. Automatic starts off; use Log only for this review release. Native execution acceptance remains pending.

Universalis batch recovery and category rules: empty/unpriced or malformed items are held individually without blocking other responses or later batches. Per-item hold reasons and detailed request errors are logged. Sale rules gain Gear/Other scopes, multiple game categories, per-rule exclusions and enabled/order controls; global category exclusions leave entire types untouched. Existing rule scope is preserved, and all collection/disposal safeguards remain in force. Native UI acceptance pending.

Direct Universalis current-world price estimates: bounded background listing requests, own-retainer filtering, upload-age validation, NQ/HQ handling, rate-limit backoff and source/status logging. Available in log-only mode; native comparison still gates every posting/repricing action. Includes non-equipment disposal protections and exact collection-copy evidence. Native acceptance remains pending.

First-run review safeguards: non-equipment disposal now requires explicit per-item permission; matching sale rules still list eligible items, while below-floor materials remain protected. Structured item proposals include live collection copy counts, post-removal evidence, armoire ownership, native/Glamaholic/gearset matches and protection reasons. Refresh failures are recorded even with execution off. Existing AutoRetainer protocol 6 remains compatible. Native acceptance of the new evidence fields is pending.

Automatic listing completion: shared stack/price planner, repeated splitting after exact acknowledgement, dynamic free-slot filling and replacement of skipped candidates. Extra stacks match own lowest price. Read-only Market preview and structured WouldList/WouldReprice records include quantity, unit/total, world, retainer and price provenance. Full native comparison/readback protections retained. Protocol 6 paired AutoRetainer update required. Log-only defaults on and automatic execution starts off; native in-game acceptance remains pending.

Pre-publication verification: log-only review defaults on, blocks all managed item actions and writes structured proposals/collection holds to review.jsonl and History. Preview and execution share last-copy simulation. Actual settings-file restart tests, missing/damaged hold-state checks and failed-release rollback checks added. Native acceptance still pending; nothing published.

Protocol 6 storage preview: ordinary dungeon/normal-raid blue exception, explicit Alliance/Savage/Coil protection, configurable dresser reserve, durable retainer-overflow holds and chat/on-screen alerts. Optional all-rule dresser cleanup includes armoire migration. Retainer transfers require exact destination acknowledgement. Local automated checks pass; native acceptance remains pending.

Repeated safety review: protocol/safety revision 5, synchronous private settings/journals, all queued work recorded before native steps, character-bound recovery, cancellation-safe completion and exact loaded inventory acknowledgements. Automatic execution is off on every load. Update AutoRetainer together. The pinned ECommons writer swallows I/O failures, so the bridge now uses an independent throwing safety ledger. Native acceptance and safe cross-zone collection refresh remain outstanding; unattended cleanup is not certified.

Author: kaldigo; based on Team Wrath's Wrath Combo

Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.
